passage: After the city painted bike lanes on Main Street, reported accidents there fell by 30 percent in a year. The mayor concludes that painting bike lanes on every street will make the whole city safer.
stem: Which of the following, if true, most seriously weakens the mayor's argument?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Cyclists in the city strongly support more bike lanes.

choices.label: B
choices.text: In the same year, Main Street got new speed cameras and accidents fell on nearby streets that received no bike lanes.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Bike lanes are inexpensive to paint compared with other road projects.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Some drivers dislike the narrower lanes on Main Street.

choices.label: E
choices.text: Other cities have also painted bike lanes on busy streets.

notes: B offers an alternative cause and a control group; D is a common irrelevant-complaint trap.
